quests.title: Remember, Remember
quests.summary: York is ready for Bonfire Night, but needs a Fizzlet to light the bonfire. Only on in the first week of November.

steps.text: Catch a Fizzlet, a little firework of a creature that only turns up in York this week. Show it to Bonfire Bernard.
Answer Bonfire Bernard's question about the occasion.

quests.reward: A tin of sparklers and some parkin.

quests.title: Samhain on the Foyle
quests.summary: Derry's Halloween carnival needs a Pooka for the parade. On from 24 October to 1 November.

steps.text: Catch a Pooka, the shapeshifting Irish trickster, which only prowls Derry at Samhain. Show it to Samhain Sinead.
Answer Samhain Sinead's question about the occasion.

quests.title: A Burns Supper
quests.summary: A Glasgow Burns Supper needs a Thistlet for the table. Only around 25 January.

steps.text: Catch a Thistlet, which only turns up in Glasgow around Burns Night. Show it to Haggis Hamish.
Answer Haggis Hamish's question about the occasion.

quests.reward: A tartan ribbon and a dish of cranachan.

quests.title: Dydd Gwyl Dewi
quests.summary: St Davids needs a Tylwyth for the St David's Day procession. On from 26 February to 2 March.

steps.text: Catch a Tylwyth, a Welsh fairy, which only comes out round St Davids at this time of year. Show it to Dewi the Daffodil.
Answer Dewi the Daffodil's question about the occasion.

quests.reward: A daffodil brooch and bara brith.

quests.title: The Paddy's Day Parade
quests.summary: Dublin's St Patrick's parade needs a Cluricaun. Only from 14 to 18 March.

steps.text: Catch a Cluricaun, a little fairy cobbler, which only turns up in Dublin around St Patrick's Day. Show it to Paddy Parade.
Answer Paddy Parade's question about the occasion.

quests.reward: A parade shamrock and soda bread.

quests.title: First-Footing at Hogmanay
quests.summary: Edinburgh needs a Beaconet to light the Hogmanay torchlight procession. On from 28 December to 2 January.

steps.text: Catch a Beaconet, a small beacon of a creature, which only turns up in Edinburgh over Hogmanay. Show it to Auld Angus.
Answer Auld Angus's question about the occasion.

quests.reward: A lump of lucky coal and some tablet.

quests.title: Beltane Fires
quests.summary: Glastonbury needs a Kindlet to light the Beltane fire. Only from 28 April to 2 May.

steps.text: Catch a Kindlet, a small spark of a creature, which only comes to Glastonbury around May Day. Show it to May Morwenna.
Answer May Morwenna's question about the occasion.

quests.reward: A May garland and a cream tea.

quests.title: The Fringe Flyerer
quests.summary: An Edinburgh Fringe performer needs a Versling to heckle. Only in August.

steps.text: Catch a Versling, a street-wise little rhymer, which only haunts Edinburgh during the Fringe. Show it to Flyer Fiona.
Answer Flyer Fiona's question about the occasion.

quests.reward: A wad of flyers and two Irn Tonics.

quests.title: Chasing the Cheese
quests.summary: Cooper's Hill needs a Gloucelet for luck before the cheese chase. Only from 24 to 31 May.

steps.text: Catch a Gloucelet, a stout little cheese-chaser, which only turns up in the Cotswolds at the end of May. Show it to Cheese Cecil.
Answer Cheese Cecil's question about the occasion.

quests.reward: A round of Double Gloucester and pork pies.

quests.title: Carnival Weekend
quests.summary: Notting Hill Carnival wants a Parakit in the band. Only from 23 to 31 August.

steps.text: Catch a Parakit, a bright city bird, which flocks to London at carnival time. Show it to Carnival Carlton.
Answer Carnival Carlton's question about the occasion.

quests.reward: A carnival feather and flasks of tea.

quests.title: Dressing the Well
quests.summary: Buxton's well dressing needs a Holtling for the blessing. Only from 4 to 19 July.

steps.text: Catch a Holtling, a little brook creature, which only comes to Buxton's well during dressing week. Show it to Petal Peggy.
Answer Petal Peggy's question about the occasion.

quests.reward: A pressed-petal panel and bottles of Buxton water.

quests.title: The Mari Lwyd Knocks
quests.summary: The Mari Lwyd is knocking on doors in Cardiff. Catch her for the sing-off. On from 20 December to 6 January.

steps.text: Catch a Mari Lwyd, the Grey Mare herself, who only walks Cardiff's streets at midwinter. Show it to Mari's Mate Mal.
Answer Mari's Mate Mal's question about the occasion.

quests.reward: A Mari Lwyd ribbon and bara brith.

quests.title: Up Helly Aa
quests.summary: Lerwick needs a Kindlet to light the torches for the galley. On round the last Tuesday of January.

steps.text: Catch a Kindlet, a little ember of a creature that only turns up round Lerwick at Up Helly Aa. Show it to Guizer Magnus.
Answer Guizer Magnus's question about the occasion.

quests.reward: A guizer's torch (the first year only) and some reestit mutton soup.
